evidence.fact: The required atomic Engine capability passed full integration gates. Runtime contract: DamageTargetFromSource and executeDamageEffect publish actual post-prevention noncombat player damage through emitPlayerDamaged; combat uses the same new player_damaged event at the point damage is applied. Existing combat-only events and monarch behavior retain their meaning. Native trigger_v2={event:player_damaged,subject:{filter:enchanted}} observes only its attached creature dealing damage to a player. qualifiedTriggerTargetSupported accepts target.controller=defending_player, which resolves to the actually damaged player for this event. Reuse a bounce atom with target={filter:creature,controller:defending_player}. The selected creature returns to its owner, and control/target legality is rechecked at resolution. Prevented damage, unrelated life loss and unrelated sources do not trigger it.

Context-only failure retained; fresh source answers are required.
